name: Bug report
description: Report a CrashExplainer bug or incorrect crash diagnosis
title: "[Bug] "
labels: ["bug"]
body:
  - type: markdown
    attributes:
      value: |
        Thanks for reporting a CrashExplainer issue!
        Please provide the information below so the problem can be reproduced.

  - type: input
    id: minecraft-version
    attributes:
      label: Minecraft Version
      description: Which Minecraft version were you using?
      placeholder: "Example: 1.20.1"
    validations:
      required: true

  - type: dropdown
    id: loader
    attributes:
      label: Mod Loader
      options:
        - Forge
        - Fabric
    validations:
      required: true

  - type: input
    id: loader-version
    attributes:
      label: Loader Version
      placeholder: "Example: Forge 47.4.0 / Fabric Loader 0.16.14"
    validations:
      required: true

  - type: input
    id: crashexplainer-version
    attributes:
      label: CrashExplainer Version
      placeholder: "Example: 1.0.0"
    validations:
      required: true

  - type: textarea
    id: problem
    attributes:
      label: What happened?
      description: Briefly describe the crash or problem.
      placeholder: Tell us what happened...
    validations:
      required: true

  - type: textarea
    id: diagnosis
    attributes:
      label: CrashExplainer Report
      description: Paste the report generated by CrashExplainer here.
      render: text
    validations:
      required: true

  - type: textarea
    id: crash-log
    attributes:
      label: Crash Report / Log
      description: Drag and drop your crash report or latest.log here. Please upload the file instead of pasting thousands of lines.
      placeholder: Drag and drop the crash report or latest.log here.
    validations:
      required: true

  - type: textarea
    id: mods
    attributes:
      label: Other Mods / Modpack
      description: List relevant mods or provide the name of the modpack.
      placeholder: List relevant mods here...

  - type: textarea
    id: incorrect
    attributes:
      label: What did CrashExplainer get wrong?
      description: If the diagnosis was incorrect, explain what you believe the actual cause was.
      placeholder: "Example: CrashExplainer reported a Mixin incompatibility, but the actual problem was a missing dependency."

  - type: checkboxes
    id: confirmation
    attributes:
      label: Confirmation
      options:
        - label: I have attached the crash report or latest.log and included CrashExplainer's generated report.
          required: true
